name: Sevenoways Universal Chat Popup
author: Diaz Xavier (Sevenoways Innovations)

sections.description: Works with WhatsApp group or any chat link. This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by WhatsApp or Meta.
sections.changelog:
2.4.4

  • Escape-everything hardening (admin and frontend) to satisfy Plugin Check.
  • Minor version bump and stability improvements.
  • Incremented CSS/JS enqueue versions for proper cache-busting.
  • Note: Users should clear browser cache/CDN if popup styling does not update immediately.

2.4.3

  • Minor version bump.
  • Stability improvements and packaging refinements.
  • Incremented CSS/JS enqueue versions for proper cache-busting.
  • Note: Users should clear browser cache/CDN if popup styling does not update immediately.

short_description: Lightweight, accessible chat popup to grow your community. Customize text, styles, timing, targeting — all from the WordPress dashboard.
description: Works with WhatsApp group or any chat link. This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by WhatsApp or Meta.
